Messages.Author: Jason
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with PRE/FOR bleeds and is blocked, then plays Majesty at superior
in the resulting combat, can he/she still play Freak Drive at the end of the
action? I would think so since Freak Drive doesn't seem to require a tapped
vampire.

Thanks,
Jason

Messages.Author: Peter Oh
Messages.Body:
"Jason" <dcij...@aol.comNOSPAM> wrote in message
news:20021122173547...@mb-mu.aol.com...


Ermmm... does it really matter? Because you can just elect to play Majesty
at inferior... so you pay the 1 blood, and you don't untap... then you untap
with Freak Drive. Right?

Peteo

Messages.Author: Jason
Messages.Body:


Well, yeah, it does matter. Let's just pretend you're trying to cycle into...
I dunno, a Parity Shift :)

You play the Majesty at superior, then if you draw the Parity Shift you'll be
untapped to call it and you can keep the Freak Drive. But if you don't draw
the PS, you may want to play the Freak Drive to try again.

Jason

Messages.Body:
